items.m: もちろん、当然
items.en: an enthusiastic way of saying yes or certainly
items.ex: "Are you coming to watch my final match?" "You bet! I'll be in the front row."
items.exJa: 「決勝戦見に来てくれる？」「もちろん！最前列にいるよ」

items.m: 何でもない、気にしないで
items.en: said to tell someone something is not important
items.ex: Did you say something just now? Oh, never mind, I found my keys already.
items.exJa: 今何か言った？あ、何でもない、もう鍵見つかったから。

items.m: まさか、嘘でしょ、絶対いやだ
items.en: expressing strong surprise, disbelief, or refusal
items.ex: No way, you actually defeated the dragon all by yourself? That's incredible!
items.exJa: 嘘でしょ、本当に一人でドラゴンを倒したの？すごい！

items.m: 完璧にやる、うまく決める
items.en: to do something perfectly or very successfully
items.ex: Your speech at the festival was amazing. You totally nailed it up there!
items.exJa: 文化祭でのスピーチ、すごかったよ。完璧に決めてたね！

items.m: やめろ、いい加減にしろ
items.en: telling someone to stop doing something annoying
items.ex: Cut it out, you two! If you keep fighting, the teacher will hear us.
items.exJa: やめなよ、二人とも！喧嘩を続けたら先生に聞こえちゃう。

items.m: ～を密告する、チクる
items.en: to tell an authority about someone else's wrongdoing
items.ex: If you rat me out to the teacher, I'll never share my snacks with you again.
items.exJa: 先生にチクったら、もう二度とお菓子分けてあげないからね。

items.m: 了解、任せて、その通り
items.en: said to agree to a request or confirm someone is correct
items.ex: Two bowls of ramen with extra pork, coming right up? You got it, boss!
items.exJa: ラーメン二杯、チャーシュー増しですね？了解です、大将！

items.m: 受けて立つ、乗った
items.en: said to accept a bet or challenge
items.ex: Loser buys lunch for a week? You're on, and I hope your wallet is full.
items.exJa: 負けた方が一週間昼飯おごり？受けて立つよ、財布の中身が多いといいね。

items.m: 失せろ、消えろ
items.en: a rude way of telling someone to go away
items.ex: I don't need help from a traitor like you. Get lost before I change my mind.
items.exJa: お前みたいな裏切り者の助けはいらない。気が変わる前に消えろ。

items.m: 私も入れて、参加する
items.en: said to show you want to be included in an activity
items.ex: A barbecue on the beach after the tournament? Count me in, I'll bring the drinks!
items.exJa: 大会の後にビーチでバーベキュー？私も入れて、飲み物持ってくね！

items.m: チンピラ、青二才
items.en: a young person who behaves in a rude, aggressive, or rebellious way
items.ex: Some punk tried to steal my bike, but I chased him down the street.
items.exJa: どこかのチンピラが俺の自転車を盗もうとしたけど、通りの先まで追いかけた。

items.m: 失せろ、あっち行け
items.en: a rude way of telling someone to go away
items.ex: This is our turf, kid. Beat it before my friends get back.
items.exJa: ここは俺たちの縄張りだ、ガキ。仲間が戻る前に失せな。

items.m: しっかりしろ、ちゃんとしろ
items.en: to become organized and in control of your actions or emotions
items.ex: The tournament is in two days, so you need to get it together and practice.
items.exJa: 大会は二日後なんだから、しっかりして練習しなきゃ。

items.m: 俺は抜ける、パスだ
items.en: said to show you do not want to take part
items.ex: Exploring a haunted hospital at midnight? Count me out, I'm staying right here.
items.exJa: 真夜中に心霊病院を探検？俺はパスだ、ここに残るよ。

items.m: 誰が気にするか、どうでもいい
items.en: said to show something is not important at all
items.ex: Who cares what the other students think? Wear the outfit you actually like.
items.exJa: 他の生徒がどう思うかなんてどうでもいいじゃん。本当に好きな服を着なよ。

items.m: マジで、本気で
items.en: seriously or truly; used to check or stress that something is true
items.ex: You're transferring to our school next week? For real? That's amazing news!
items.exJa: 来週うちの学校に転校してくるの？マジで？最高のニュースだよ！

items.m: 手加減する、遠慮する、控える
items.en: to not use your full strength, or to not show your feelings
items.ex: Don't hold back just because I'm your friend. Fight me with everything you've got.
items.exJa: 友達だからって手加減しないで。全力でかかってきて。

items.m: 怪しげな、危なっかしい
items.en: seeming unsafe, unreliable, or dishonest
items.ex: This alley looks kind of sketchy at night. Let's take the main road instead.
items.exJa: この路地、夜はちょっと怪しげだね。大通りを通ろうよ。

items.m: バレた、見つかった
items.en: caught doing something wrong
items.ex: Busted! I saw you sneaking back into the dorm at three in the morning.
items.exJa: 見つけた！朝の3時に寮へこっそり戻るとこ見たよ。

items.m: 弱虫、意気地なし
items.en: a weak person who lacks courage or strength
items.ex: Stop crying over a tiny scratch. Are you a warrior or a wimp?
items.exJa: かすり傷くらいで泣くな。お前は戦士か、それとも弱虫か？

items.m: 黙れ、うるさい、まさか
items.en: a rude order to stop talking; also an expression of disbelief
items.ex: Shut up and listen for once! The enemy could be hiding anywhere around us.
items.exJa: たまには黙って聞け！敵がこの辺のどこに隠れていてもおかしくないんだ。

items.m: 惜しかったな、その手には乗らない
items.en: said when someone's attempt fails, often to show you are not fooled
items.ex: Nice try, but I know that's not really your grandmother on the phone.
items.exJa: 残念でした、電話の相手が本当はおばあちゃんじゃないって分かってるよ。

items.m: 頑張れ、踏ん張れ
items.en: encouraging someone to keep going through a hard time
items.ex: Hang in there, the medics are on their way. Just keep your eyes open for me.
items.exJa: 頑張れ、救護班がこっちに向かってる。とにかく目を開けていてくれ。

items.m: 遊ぶ、ぶらぶらする、一緒に過ごす
items.en: to spend relaxed time with friends or in a place
items.ex: Do you want to hang out at my place after school and play video games?
items.exJa: 放課後うちで遊ばない？ゲームしようよ。

items.m: 恨みっこなし、悪く思うな
items.en: said to show you are not angry or hope someone isn't angry
items.ex: I had to beat you to reach the final. No hard feelings, right?
items.exJa: 決勝に行くにはお前を倒すしかなかった。恨みっこなしだよな？

items.m: 大人になれ、子供みたいなことするな
items.en: telling someone to stop behaving in a childish way
items.ex: Hiding my shoes as a prank? Grow up, we're seventeen, not seven.
items.exJa: イタズラで私の靴を隠すとか？大人になりなよ、7歳じゃなくて17歳でしょ。

items.m: どうでもいい、勝手にすれば
items.en: said to show you do not care or are annoyed
items.ex: "You should apologize to her." "Whatever, it's not my fault she got upset."
items.exJa: 「彼女に謝るべきだよ」「どうでもいいよ、あいつが怒ったのは俺のせいじゃない」

items.m: 怖気づいてやめる
items.en: to decide not to do something because you are afraid
items.ex: You promised to confess to her today. Don't chicken out at the last second!
items.exJa: 今日彼女に告白するって約束しただろ。土壇場で怖気づくなよ！

items.m: また今度にする、次の機会に
items.en: to politely decline an offer but suggest accepting it later
items.ex: I'd love to grab dinner, but I'm exhausted. Can I take a rain check on that?
items.exJa: 夕食行きたいけど、くたくたなんだ。また今度にしてもいい？

items.m: 本題に入る、要点を言う
items.en: to get to the important point without wasting time
items.ex: We don't have all night, so cut to the chase. Who sent you here?
items.exJa: 一晩中付き合ってる暇はない、本題に入れ。誰に送り込まれた？

items.m: 我慢しろ、泣き言を言うな
items.en: to accept a difficult situation without complaining
items.ex: Training is supposed to hurt, so suck it up and give me fifty more push-ups.
items.exJa: 修行は辛くて当然だ。泣き言を言わずに腕立てをあと50回やれ。

items.m: しっかりしろ、落ち着け
items.en: telling someone to control their emotions and act sensibly
items.ex: Get a grip on yourself! Panicking won't help us find a way out of here.
items.exJa: しっかりしろ！パニックになってもここから出る方法は見つからないぞ。

items.m: あなたには関係ない
items.en: said rudely to refuse to share private information
items.ex: Where I was last night is none of your business, so stop asking me.
items.exJa: 昨日の夜どこにいたかなんてあなたには関係ないでしょ、聞かないで。

items.m: 決まりだ、交渉成立
items.en: said to agree to an arrangement or bargain
items.ex: You help me with math, and I'll teach you to skateboard? It's a deal!
items.exJa: 数学を教えてくれたら、スケボーを教えるってこと？決まりだね！

items.m: 状況を理解する、分かる
items.en: to understand a situation, especially one not fully explained
items.ex: She keeps leaving whenever you walk in. Do you get the picture yet?
items.exJa: 君が入ってくるたびに彼女は出て行くよね。そろそろ分かった？

items.m: 怪しい、うさんくさい
items.en: seeming dishonest or possibly illegal
items.ex: That shady merchant sold us a potion that turned out to be colored water.
items.exJa: あのうさんくさい商人が売ったポーション、ただの色水だった。

items.m: ～に片思いしている、～が好き
items.en: to have romantic feelings for someone, often secretly
items.ex: Everyone in class knows you have a crush on the student council president.
items.exJa: 生徒会長のこと好きなの、クラスのみんな知ってるよ。

items.m: お前が言うな
items.en: saying someone is guilty of the same fault they criticize
items.ex: You're calling me lazy? You're one to talk, you slept through the entire battle!
items.exJa: 私が怠け者だって？あんたが言う？戦いの間ずっと寝てたくせに！

items.m: ダサい、つまらない、しょぼい
items.en: boring, uncool, or not convincing
items.ex: Your excuse about the cat eating your homework is so lame, nobody believes it.
items.exJa: 猫が宿題を食べたなんて言い訳、しょぼすぎて誰も信じないよ。

items.m: じっとしてろ、そこを動くな
items.en: to remain in the same place without moving
items.ex: Stay put behind this rock while I check whether the bridge is safe.
items.exJa: 橋が安全か確かめる間、この岩の陰でじっとしてろ。

items.m: さあ、やるぞ、行くぞ
items.en: said to show you are ready and determined to begin
items.ex: Everyone knows the plan, so grab your weapons. Alright, team, let's do this!
items.exJa: みんな作戦は分かってるな、武器を取れ。よし、チーム、行くぞ！

items.m: 行動を起こす、アプローチする
items.en: to take action, especially to start a romance or attack
items.ex: If you like her so much, you should make a move before someone else does.
items.exJa: そんなに好きなら、誰かに取られる前に行動を起こすべきだよ。

items.m: ～をいじめる、～に絡む
items.en: to repeatedly treat someone unkindly or tease them
items.ex: Stop picking on the first-years. Go find someone your own size if you want a fight.
items.exJa: 一年生をいじめるのはやめろ。喧嘩したいなら自分と同じくらいの相手を探せ。

items.m: ぶちのめす、こてんぱんにする
items.en: to defeat or beat someone easily
items.ex: Next time we meet in the ring, I'm going to kick your butt, I promise.
items.exJa: 次にリングで会ったら、お前をこてんぱんにしてやる、約束だ。

items.m: 口を慎め、言葉に気をつけろ
items.en: warning someone to stop speaking rudely
items.ex: Watch your mouth when you talk about my family, or you'll regret it.
items.exJa: 俺の家族のことを話すときは口を慎め。さもないと後悔するぞ。

items.m: 現れる、来る、顔を出す
items.en: to arrive or appear, especially when expected
items.ex: We waited at the shrine for two hours, but he never showed up.
items.exJa: 神社で2時間待ったけど、彼は結局現れなかった。

items.m: （他人の家に）泊まる、寝落ちする
items.en: to sleep somewhere for a night, often unplanned, or fall asleep quickly
items.ex: I missed the last bus home. Can I crash on your couch tonight?
items.exJa: 終バス逃しちゃった。今夜あなたのソファに泊めてもらえる？

items.m: 失せろ、とっとと出て行け
items.en: a rude way of telling someone to leave
items.ex: If you're only here to make fun of my shop, take a hike.
items.exJa: 俺の店を馬鹿にしに来ただけなら、とっとと出て行け。

items.m: 全力を尽くす
items.en: to try as hard as you possibly can
items.ex: Whatever happens in the audition, just give it your all and have no regrets.
items.exJa: オーディションで何があっても、全力を尽くして悔いを残さないで。

items.m: （急に）抜ける、すっぽかす
items.en: to leave suddenly or fail to show up for plans
items.ex: We planned this trip for weeks, and you're going to bail on us the night before?
items.exJa: 何週間もかけて計画した旅行なのに、前の晩にドタキャンするつもり？

items.m: 不気味な、気味の悪い
items.en: strange or frightening in a way that makes you uneasy
items.ex: This abandoned school is really creepy at night. Did you hear that piano just now?
items.exJa: この廃校、夜は本当に不気味だね。今ピアノの音聞こえなかった？

items.m: 遅かったじゃないか、何してたの
items.en: asking why someone arrived or acted later than expected
items.ex: What took you so long? I've been holding off these soldiers by myself for an hour!
items.exJa: 遅かったじゃないか！1時間も一人で兵士を食い止めてたんだぞ！

items.m: 静かにして、声を落として
items.en: telling someone to be quieter
items.ex: Keep it down, you guys! If the librarian hears us, we'll get kicked out.
items.exJa: みんな静かにして！司書さんに聞こえたら追い出されちゃう。

items.m: 夢でも見てろ、ありえない
items.en: said to show that what someone hopes for will never happen
items.ex: You think you'll beat my high score by tonight? In your dreams, buddy.
items.exJa: 今夜までに俺のハイスコア抜けると思ってる？夢でも見てな。

items.m: 負け犬、ダメなやつ
items.en: a person regarded as unsuccessful or not worth respect
items.ex: Nobody wants to sit with that loser, so he always eats lunch on the roof.
items.exJa: 誰もあの負け犬と座りたがらないから、あいついつも屋上で昼飯食べてる。

items.m: 口だけ
items.en: describing someone who boasts but never acts
items.ex: He keeps saying he'll challenge the champion, but he's all talk and no action.
items.exJa: あいつはチャンピオンに挑むって言い続けてるけど、口だけで何もしない。

items.w: you've got to be kidding me
items.m: 冗談だろ、嘘だろ
items.en: expressing disbelief or annoyance at something surprising
items.ex: The exam is tomorrow and you haven't even opened the book? You've got to be kidding me.
items.f: You've got to be kidding me
items.exJa: 試験は明日なのに、まだ教科書も開いてないの？冗談でしょ。

items.m: 現実を見ろ、ふざけるな
items.en: telling someone to be realistic and stop being foolish
items.ex: Get real, you can't become a pro gamer if you only practice on weekends.
items.exJa: 現実を見なよ、週末しか練習しないでプロゲーマーになれるわけないじゃん。

items.m: 無理するな、落ち着いて、じゃあね
items.en: to relax and avoid stress or effort; also used as a goodbye
items.ex: You just got out of the hospital, so take it easy and let us handle the patrol.
items.exJa: 退院したばかりなんだから無理しないで、見回りは私たちに任せて。

items.m: お高くとまった、気取った
items.en: unfriendly because you think you are better than others
items.ex: Everyone thought the new student was stuck-up, but she was actually just shy.
items.exJa: みんな転校生はお高くとまってると思ってたけど、実はただ人見知りだった。

items.m: 久しぶり
items.en: a casual greeting for someone you have not met for a while
items.ex: Long time no see! You've gotten so tall since we graduated from middle school.
items.exJa: 久しぶり！中学卒業してからすごく背が伸びたね。

items.m: 失敗する、台無しにする
items.en: to make a mistake or spoil something
items.ex: I messed up the lyrics during the concert, but the audience didn't seem to notice.
items.exJa: コンサートで歌詞を間違えちゃったけど、お客さんは気づいてなかったみたい。

items.m: 嫌なやつ、ひどいやつ
items.en: a rude, selfish, or unkind person
items.ex: You laughed when she fell down? Don't be such a jerk and go help her up.
items.exJa: 彼女が転んだのに笑ったの？最低なことしないで、助け起こしてあげなよ。

items.m: 勝負だ、始まりだ
items.en: said to announce a competition or challenge has begun
items.ex: So you've finally accepted my challenge to a cooking duel? Game on!
items.exJa: ついに料理対決の挑戦を受けたのね？勝負よ！

items.m: あっち行け、うるさい
items.en: an informal, impolite way to tell someone to leave
items.ex: Buzz off, I'm trying to concentrate on this puzzle and you keep talking.
items.exJa: あっち行ってよ、このパズルに集中したいのにずっと喋ってるんだから。

items.m: 大目に見る、甘くしてやる
items.en: to be less critical of someone because of their situation
items.ex: Cut him some slack, he stayed up all night taking care of his sick sister.
items.exJa: 大目に見てやれよ、病気の妹の看病で一晩中起きてたんだから。

items.m: やめろ、よせ
items.en: telling someone firmly to stop doing something
items.ex: Knock it off with the jokes, this is a serious meeting about the enemy's plans.
items.exJa: 冗談はよせ、これは敵の作戦についての真面目な会議だ。

items.m: そんなの分かってるよ、まったくだ
items.en: said to show you already know and strongly agree
items.ex: "Your brother is so stubborn." "You're telling me, I've lived with him for sixteen years."
items.exJa: 「君のお兄さん、本当に頑固だね」「言われなくても分かってるよ、16年一緒に住んでるんだから」

items.m: 誓うよ、絶対本当
items.en: said to promise that you are telling the truth
items.ex: I didn't eat your pudding, cross my heart. It must have been the cat.
items.exJa: あなたのプリンは食べてないよ、誓う。きっと猫だよ。

items.m: ごめん、俺のミス
items.en: an informal way of admitting a mistake and apologizing
items.ex: Oops, I knocked your lunch off the table. My bad, I'll buy you another one.
items.exJa: おっと、君の弁当をテーブルから落としちゃった。ごめん、新しいの買うよ。

items.m: いい度胸してるな、よくもぬけぬけと
items.en: said when someone acts in a shockingly rude or bold way
items.ex: You've got some nerve showing your face here after betraying our guild.
items.exJa: ギルドを裏切っておいてよくもここに顔を出せたな、いい度胸だ。

items.m: どうしたんだ、何があった
items.en: asking what is happening or why something is strange
items.ex: You've been ignoring my texts for three days. What gives? Are you mad at me?
items.exJa: 3日もメッセージ無視してるよね。どうしたの？怒ってる？

items.m: 勝手にしろ、好きにすれば
items.en: said, often with annoyance, to let someone do as they wish
items.ex: Fine, have it your way. But don't come crying to me when the plan fails.
items.exJa: 分かった、勝手にしろ。でも作戦が失敗しても泣きついてくるなよ。

items.m: もうやめろ、いい加減にしろ
items.en: telling someone to stop talking about or doing something annoying
items.ex: Give it a rest already, you've been complaining about the rain for an hour.
items.exJa: もういい加減にしてよ、1時間も雨の文句言ってるじゃない。

items.m: 悪気はないけど、気を悪くしないで
items.en: said before a remark that might upset someone
items.ex: No offense, but your cooking tastes like burnt rubber.
items.exJa: 悪気はないんだけど、君の料理は焦げたゴムみたいな味がする。

items.m: 気持ち悪いやつ、変なやつ
items.en: an unpleasant person who makes others uncomfortable
items.ex: That creep keeps following me home from school, and it's starting to scare me.
items.exJa: あの気持ち悪い男がずっと学校から家までついてきて、怖くなってきた。

items.m: 鈍感な、何も分かっていない
items.en: not knowing or noticing something obvious
items.ex: She's been dropping hints for months, but he's so clueless he still hasn't noticed.
items.exJa: 彼女は何か月もヒントを出してるのに、彼は鈍感すぎてまだ気づいてない。

items.m: かかってこい、望むところだ
items.en: said to show you are ready and eager to face a challenge
items.ex: You think your new technique can beat me? Bring it on, I'm not afraid!
items.exJa: 新しい技で俺に勝てると思ってるのか？かかってこい、怖くなんかないぞ！

items.m: 目を覚ませ、しっかりしろ
items.en: to suddenly stop being in a bad or confused mental state
items.ex: Snap out of it! That spell is controlling your mind, it's me, your best friend!
items.exJa: 目を覚まして！その呪文に心を操られてるの、私だよ、親友の！

items.m: （嫌なことを）しつこく言う
items.en: to keep reminding someone of their failure or embarrassment
items.ex: Yes, I know I lost to a first-year. You don't have to rub it in.
items.exJa: ああ、一年生に負けたのは分かってる。しつこく言わなくていいだろ。

items.m: 調子に乗るな、図に乗るな
items.en: warning someone not to risk losing what they have by asking for more
items.ex: I let you off once, rookie, so don't push your luck by asking for another favor.
items.exJa: 一度は見逃してやったんだ、新入り。もう一つ頼みごとをして調子に乗るなよ。

items.m: ～にうんざりしている
items.en: to be annoyed and tired of something that has continued too long
items.ex: I'm fed up with your lies, so tell me the truth right now or leave.
items.exJa: あなたの嘘にはもううんざり。今すぐ本当のことを言うか、出て行って。

items.m: 受け入れろ、我慢しろ
items.en: telling someone to accept a situation without complaining
items.ex: I'm the captain now, not you. Deal with it and follow my orders.
items.exJa: 今は俺がキャプテンだ、お前じゃない。受け入れて俺の指示に従え。

items.m: 生意気な、うぬぼれた
items.en: too confident in an annoying or arrogant way
items.ex: Don't get cocky just because you won one round. The real fight starts now.
items.exJa: 一回勝ったくらいで調子に乗るなよ。本当の戦いはこれからだ。

items.m: 先生のお気に入り
items.en: a student the teacher clearly favors, often resented by others
items.ex: Of course she got the lead role again. She's the teacher's pet.
items.exJa: もちろん彼女がまた主役だよ。先生のお気に入りだもん。

items.m: 本当にそうだよね、まったくだ
items.en: said to strongly agree, especially about something unpleasant
items.ex: "Our new teacher gives way too much homework." "Tell me about it, I barely slept."
items.exJa: 「新しい先生、宿題多すぎない？」「ほんとそれ、ほとんど寝てないよ」

items.m: 甘いな、夢見てろ
items.en: said mockingly to someone whose hopes are unrealistic
items.ex: You think the teacher will cancel the exam because you asked nicely? Dream on.
items.exJa: お願いしたから先生が試験を中止してくれると思う？甘いね。

items.m: （先に）取った、予約
items.en: a claim to have the right to something before others
items.ex: I call dibs on the window seat, so don't even think about sitting there.
items.exJa: 窓側の席は私が先に取ったからね、座ろうなんて思わないでよ。

items.m: 任せて、すぐやる
items.en: said to show you will deal with a task right away
items.ex: Somebody needs to hack the security cameras before the guards return. I'm on it!
items.exJa: 警備員が戻る前に誰かが監視カメラをハッキングしないと。任せて！

items.m: 乗った、俺もやる
items.en: said to agree to join a plan or activity
items.ex: You're sneaking into the festival after dark? Sounds fun, I'm in.
items.exJa: 暗くなってからお祭りに忍び込むの？面白そう、私も乗った。

items.m: 借りができたな、恩に着る
items.en: said to thank someone and promise to return a favor
items.ex: Thanks for covering for me with the captain. I owe you one, seriously.
items.exJa: 隊長にうまくごまかしてくれてありがとう。本当に借りができたよ。

items.m: ちょっと待て、焦るな
items.en: telling someone to wait and not act too quickly
items.ex: Hold your horses! We can't charge in until we know how many guards there are.
items.exJa: ちょっと待て！見張りが何人いるか分かるまで突入はできない。

items.m: おごるよ、私のおごり
items.en: said to tell someone you will pay for them
items.ex: Order whatever you like from the menu, it's my treat for helping me move.
items.exJa: メニューから好きなもの頼んで。引っ越しを手伝ってくれたお礼に私がおごるよ。

items.m: ～にお手柔らかに、手加減する
items.en: to treat someone gently or less strictly
items.ex: Go easy on the new recruit, sensei. It's only his first day at the dojo.
items.exJa: 新入りには手加減してあげてください、先生。まだ道場に来て初日なんです。

items.m: 任せて、私に任せろ
items.en: said to tell someone you will take care of something
items.ex: The lock looks tricky, but leave it to me. I've opened tougher ones than this.
items.exJa: 厄介な鍵みたいだけど、任せて。もっと難しいのも開けたことあるから。

items.m: だから何、それがどうした
items.en: said to show something does not matter to you
items.ex: So what if he's the strongest fighter in the academy? I'm still going to challenge him.
items.exJa: あいつが学園最強だからって何だ？それでも俺は挑むぞ。

items.m: パニクる、取り乱す
items.en: to suddenly become very upset, scared, or excited
items.ex: Don't freak out, but there's a huge spider sitting on your shoulder right now.
items.exJa: パニクらないでね、でも今あなたの肩に大きいクモが乗ってる。

items.m: 何か裏があるんだろ、条件は何だ
items.en: asking what hidden problem or condition comes with an offer
items.ex: You'll give me the sword for free? Come on, nobody's that generous. What's the catch?
items.exJa: その剣をタダでくれるって？まさか、そんなに気前のいい奴はいない。何か裏があるんだろ？

items.m: それもそうだ、もっともだ
items.en: said to accept that a point or decision is reasonable
items.ex: "I can't come because I promised to help my mom." "Fair enough, maybe next time."
items.exJa: 「お母さんを手伝う約束したから行けないんだ」「それなら仕方ないね、また今度」

items.m: 落ち着け、頭を冷やせ
items.en: telling someone to calm down or stop being so angry
items.ex: Cool it, both of you. Fighting in the hallway will just get us all detention.
items.exJa: 二人とも頭を冷やせ。廊下で喧嘩したら全員居残りになるだけだ。

items.m: 誤解しないで
items.en: said to prevent someone from misunderstanding what you mean
items.ex: Don't get me wrong, I respect you, but your plan is going to get us killed.
items.exJa: 誤解しないでくれ、尊敬はしてる。でもお前の作戦だと俺たちは死ぬぞ。

items.m: 楽勝、朝飯前
items.en: something that is very easy to do
items.ex: Beating these low-level monsters is a piece of cake. Let's head to the boss room.
items.exJa: こんな雑魚モンスターを倒すのは朝飯前だ。ボス部屋に行こう。

items.m: 秘密をばらす、白状する
items.en: to reveal secret information
items.ex: Don't spill the beans about the surprise party, she still thinks we forgot her birthday.
items.exJa: サプライズパーティーのことばらさないでね、彼女は誕生日を忘れられたと思ってるんだから。

items.m: 間に合う、助かる、成功する
items.en: to arrive in time, survive, or succeed
items.ex: The ship leaves in five minutes. If we run, we can still make it!
items.exJa: 船は5分後に出る。走ればまだ間に合う！

items.m: 言いなりになる人、ちょろい人
items.en: a person who is easily persuaded or defeated
items.ex: She's no pushover. If you try to bully her, she'll fight back twice as hard.
items.exJa: 彼女はちょろくないよ。いじめようとしたら倍の力でやり返してくる。

items.m: ベタな、くさい、安っぽい
items.en: too sentimental, obvious, or cheap to be taken seriously
items.ex: His love letter was so cheesy that I couldn't stop laughing while reading it.
items.exJa: 彼のラブレター、くさすぎて読みながら笑いが止まらなかった。

items.w: I didn't sign up for this
items.m: こんなの聞いてない
items.en: complaining that a situation is worse than what you agreed to
items.ex: You said this was a simple delivery job. I didn't sign up for this monster fight!
items.f: I didn't sign up for this
items.exJa: 簡単な配達の仕事だって言ったじゃないか。モンスターと戦うなんて聞いてないぞ！

items.m: お気の毒さま、残念だったな
items.en: said, often unsympathetically, about someone's bad fortune
items.ex: You missed the last train? Tough luck, I guess you're walking home tonight.
items.exJa: 終電逃した？お気の毒さま、今夜は歩いて帰るしかないね。

items.m: 下がれ、手を引け、ほっといて
items.en: to move away or stop pressuring or threatening someone
items.ex: Back off! If you lay one finger on my sister, you'll regret it.
items.exJa: 下がれ！妹に指一本でも触れたら後悔するぞ。

items.m: 自業自得だ、望み通りにしてやる
items.en: saying someone deserves a bad result because they caused it
items.ex: I warned you three times not to provoke me. Now you asked for it!
items.exJa: 三回も挑発するなと警告したよな。望み通りにしてやるよ！

items.m: 今しかない
items.en: said when you must act immediately or lose the chance forever
items.ex: The gate is closing in ten seconds. It's now or never, so run!
items.exJa: 門があと10秒で閉まる。今しかない、走れ！

items.m: 金欠の、一文無しの
items.en: having no money
items.ex: I spent all my allowance on manga, so I'm totally broke until next month.
items.exJa: お小遣い全部漫画に使っちゃったから、来月まで完全に金欠。

items.m: 気をつけて、前もって知らせる
items.en: a warning or advance notice about something
items.ex: Just a heads up, the principal is checking everyone's uniforms at the gate today.
items.exJa: 一応知らせとくけど、今日は校長が校門で全員の制服をチェックしてるよ。

items.m: 遠慮しとく、パス
items.en: a casual way to decline an offer or invitation
items.ex: Thanks for the offer of fried grasshoppers, but I think I'll pass this time.
items.exJa: バッタの素揚げ、勧めてくれてありがとう。でも今回は遠慮しとく。

items.m: どうして、なんで
items.en: an informal way of asking why
items.ex: How come you never told me that you used to be a famous swordsman?
items.exJa: 昔有名な剣士だったって、なんで一度も話してくれなかったの？

items.m: これで貸し借りなしだ
items.en: said when no one owes the other anything anymore
items.ex: You saved my life back then, and now I've saved yours. We're even.
items.exJa: あの時お前は俺の命を救った。そして今、俺がお前を救った。これで貸し借りなしだ。

items.m: うぬぼれるな、何様のつもりだ
items.en: telling someone to stop acting as if they are so important
items.ex: Get over yourself, prince. Out here in the wilderness, nobody cares about your title.
items.exJa: うぬぼれるなよ、王子様。この荒野じゃ誰もお前の肩書きなんか気にしない。

items.m: 全然分かってないね、想像以上だよ
items.en: saying something is far more extreme than the listener imagines
items.ex: You have no idea how long I waited for this moment to finally face you.
items.exJa: ついにお前と向き合うこの瞬間を、俺がどれだけ待ったか分かるまい。

items.m: そう思いたいだろうな、甘いな
items.en: telling someone that what they hope for will not happen
items.ex: You think I'll let you win just because you're my little brother? You wish!
items.exJa: 弟だからって勝たせてもらえると思ってるの？甘いね！

items.m: 気持ち悪い、キモい
items.en: very unpleasant or disgusting
items.ex: Ew, gross! Who left a half-eaten sandwich under the couch for a month?
items.exJa: うわ、気持ち悪い！誰がソファの下に食べかけのサンドイッチを一か月も放置したの？

items.m: ～を裏切る
items.en: to betray someone who trusted you
items.ex: I trusted you like a brother, and you stabbed me in the back for money!
items.exJa: 兄弟のように信じてたのに、金のために俺を裏切ったのか！

items.m: 今日はここまでにする
items.en: to stop working on something for the rest of the day
items.ex: We've been training since dawn and everyone is exhausted. Let's call it a day.
items.exJa: 夜明けから修行してみんなくたくただ。今日はここまでにしよう。

items.m: よく覚えておけ、言っておくがな
items.en: said to stress that what you predict will certainly happen
items.ex: Mark my words, one day I'll become the greatest chef this town has ever seen.
items.exJa: よく覚えておけ、いつか俺はこの町一番の料理人になってみせる。

items.m: へまをする、台無しにする
items.en: to make a bad mistake or ruin something
items.ex: I really screwed up the mission, and now the whole team is in danger because of me.
items.exJa: 任務で大失敗しちゃって、僕のせいでチーム全体が危険にさらされてる。

items.m: しっかりしろ、気を取り直せ
items.en: to calm down and regain control after being upset
items.ex: I know you're scared, but pull yourself together. The villagers are counting on us.
items.exJa: 怖いのは分かる、でもしっかりしろ。村人たちが私たちを頼りにしてるんだ。

items.m: 勘弁してよ、いい加減にして
items.en: expressing annoyance or disbelief at something unreasonable
items.ex: Another surprise quiz today? Oh, give me a break, we just had one yesterday!
items.exJa: 今日も抜き打ちテスト？勘弁してよ、昨日もやったばかりじゃん！

items.m: そんなの信じない
items.en: said to show you do not believe an explanation
items.ex: You say you were studying in the library all night? Sorry, I'm not buying it.
items.exJa: 一晩中図書館で勉強してたって？悪いけど、そんなの信じないよ。

items.m: 任せろ、お前の味方だ、援護する
items.en: said to promise support and protection to someone
items.ex: Go ahead and face him, partner. Don't worry, I've got your back no matter what.
items.exJa: 行けよ、相棒。心配するな、何があっても俺がついてる。

items.m: 詮索好きな、おせっかいな
items.en: too interested in other people's private affairs
items.ex: Our nosy neighbor keeps peeking through the curtains whenever a friend visits me.
items.exJa: 詮索好きなお隣さんは、友達が来るたびにカーテン越しに覗いてくる。

items.m: 背後に気をつけろ、用心しろ
items.en: warning someone to be careful because others may harm them
items.ex: Watch your back in this city, kid. Half the people here would sell you out.
items.exJa: この街では用心しな、坊主。ここの連中の半分はお前を売るぞ。

items.m: 偉そうな、仕切りたがる
items.en: always telling other people what to do
items.ex: Just because you're the class rep doesn't mean you can be so bossy with everyone.
items.exJa: 学級委員だからって、みんなにそんなに偉そうにしていいわけじゃないよ。

items.m: 覚えてろ、この借りは返す
items.en: a threat that someone will suffer for what they have done
items.ex: You destroyed my village and everyone I loved. I swear you'll pay for this!
items.exJa: お前は俺の村も愛する者もすべて奪った。誓って、この報いは受けさせる！

items.m: ドジ、不器用な人
items.en: a clumsy person who often drops things or trips
items.ex: I tripped over my own feet in front of the whole school. I'm such a klutz.
items.exJa: 全校生徒の前で自分の足につまずいちゃった。ほんとドジだな、私。

items.m: 落ち着け、リラックスしろ
items.en: to calm down and relax
items.ex: Chill out, it's just a practice match. Nobody's going to get expelled for losing.
items.exJa: 落ち着けって、ただの練習試合だよ。負けたって退学になるわけじゃない。

items.m: 本気だよ、冗談じゃない
items.en: said to stress that you are serious
items.ex: Thank you for saving me back there. I mean it, I wouldn't be alive without you.
items.exJa: さっきは助けてくれてありがとう。本気で言ってるの、あなたがいなきゃ生きてなかった。

items.m: いざという時に、困った時に
items.en: in an emergency or when nothing better is available
items.ex: This old dagger isn't much, but it'll protect you in a pinch.
items.exJa: この古い短剣は大したものじゃないが、いざという時には身を守れる。

items.m: くたくたの、疲れ果てた
items.en: extremely tired
items.ex: After that three-hour training session, I'm completely wiped out and need a nap.
items.exJa: 3時間の練習の後で、もうくたくた。昼寝しなきゃ。

items.m: ～を我慢する、～に耐える
items.en: to accept or tolerate something unpleasant
items.ex: I can't put up with his snoring anymore, so I'm moving to another tent.
items.exJa: あいつのいびきにはもう耐えられないから、別のテントに移るよ。

items.m: さっさと言え、はっきり言え
items.en: telling someone to say what they are hesitating to say
items.ex: You've been staring at me all day. If you have something to say, spit it out.
items.exJa: 一日中こっちを見てるけど、言いたいことがあるならはっきり言えよ。

items.m: その意気だ
items.en: said to praise someone's positive or determined attitude
items.ex: You'll train again tomorrow even after losing today? That's the spirit, kid!
items.exJa: 今日負けても明日また修行するって？その意気だ、坊主！

items.m: 余計なお世話だ、口を出すな
items.en: telling someone not to interfere in your private affairs
items.ex: Who I spend my weekends with is none of your concern, so mind your own business.
items.exJa: 週末に誰と過ごすかはあなたに関係ないでしょ、余計なお世話よ。

items.m: バカ、アホ
items.en: a very stupid person
items.ex: You set the kitchen on fire making toast? You absolute moron!
items.exJa: トースト焼いて台所を燃やしたの？本当にバカなんだから！

items.m: ～はどうしたの、何なんだ
items.en: asking the reason for something strange or unusual
items.ex: What's with the giant backpack? We're only going to the park for an hour.
items.exJa: その巨大なリュックは何？公園に1時間行くだけだよ。

items.m: 捕まえた、引っかかった、了解
items.en: said when catching or tricking someone, or to mean you understand
items.ex: Gotcha! You fell for my fake treasure chest, just like I planned.
items.exJa: 引っかかった！計画通り、偽の宝箱にまんまと騙されたね。

items.m: お前はもう終わりだ、覚悟しろ
items.en: a threat that someone is in serious trouble
items.ex: When the boss finds out you lost the shipment, you're dead meat.
items.exJa: 積荷をなくしたってボスにバレたら、お前はもう終わりだぞ。

items.m: もう我慢できない、もう限界だ
items.en: said when you have become too angry or annoyed to tolerate more
items.ex: That does it! You've broken my game console for the last time, little brother!
items.exJa: もう我慢できない！私のゲーム機を壊すのはこれで最後よ、この弟め！

items.m: 短気なやつ、カッとなりやすい人
items.en: a person who gets angry quickly and acts without thinking
items.ex: Keep that hothead away from the negotiations, or he'll start a war.
items.exJa: あの短気な奴を交渉から遠ざけておけ、さもないと戦争を始めかねない。

items.m: 私の目の黒いうちは許さない
items.en: said to show you will do anything to stop something happening
items.ex: You want to marry my daughter, you lazy bum? Over my dead body!
items.exJa: このろくでなしが娘と結婚したいだと？わしの目の黒いうちは許さん！

items.m: まさか、ありえない
items.en: said scornfully to show something is very unlikely
items.ex: Me, go on a date with that arrogant show-off? As if! Not in a million years.
items.exJa: 私があの自慢屋とデート？ありえない！絶対にないから。

items.m: キレる、取り乱す
items.en: to suddenly become very angry or lose control of your emotions
items.ex: When he insulted her drawing, she totally lost it and threw her paints at him.
items.exJa: 絵をけなされて、彼女は完全にキレて絵の具を投げつけた。

items.m: べたべたする、まとわりつく
items.en: wanting to be close to someone all the time in an annoying way
items.ex: My little sister has been so clingy since I said I'm moving to Tokyo.
items.exJa: 東京に引っ越すって言ってから、妹がずっとべったりくっついてくる。

items.m: （危機・病気を）乗り切る、持ちこたえる
items.en: to survive a serious illness, injury, or difficult situation
items.ex: The doctor said his wound is deep, but he's strong enough to pull through.
items.exJa: 医者によると傷は深いけど、彼なら持ちこたえられるくらい強いって。

items.m: 変人、変なやつ
items.en: a person who behaves in a very strange way
items.ex: The new kid talks to his plants every morning. Everyone thinks he's a weirdo.
items.exJa: 転校生は毎朝植物に話しかけてる。みんなあいつを変人だと思ってる。

items.m: ちょっと待って、しっかりつかまって
items.en: to wait for a short time, or to hold something tightly
items.ex: Hang on a second, I think I dropped my phone somewhere near the station.
items.exJa: ちょっと待って、駅の近くでスマホ落としたかも。

items.m: 目立ちたがり、自慢屋
items.en: a person who tries to impress others with their skills or possessions
items.ex: He did a backflip in front of the whole class again. What a show-off.
items.exJa: あいつまたクラス全員の前でバク転してた。ほんと目立ちたがりだね。

items.m: ざまあみろ、自業自得だ
items.en: saying someone deserves the bad thing that happened to them
items.ex: You cheated on the test and got caught? Serves you right.
items.exJa: テストでカンニングしてバレたって？自業自得だね。

items.m: 全力を出す、本気を出す
items.en: to use all your energy and effort
items.ex: This is the final round, so I'm going to go all out from the very start.
items.exJa: これが最終ラウンドだから、最初から全力で行く。

items.m: もう帰る、付き合ってられない
items.en: said when you are leaving, often because you are annoyed
items.ex: If you're going to keep arguing like this all night, I'm out of here.
items.exJa: 一晩中こんなふうに言い争うつもりなら、私はもう帰る。

items.m: やっぱりね、思った通り
items.en: said when something you suspected turns out to be true
items.ex: I knew it! You were the masked thief all along, weren't you?
items.exJa: やっぱりね！ずっとあなたが仮面の泥棒だったんでしょ？

items.m: でたらめばかり言う、嘘っぱち
items.en: talking nonsense or not telling the truth
items.ex: He claims he defeated a hundred bandits alone, but he's totally full of it.
items.exJa: あいつは一人で山賊を百人倒したって言ってるけど、完全なでたらめだ。

items.m: 別に～ってわけじゃない
items.en: used to deny something, often when it is actually true
items.ex: It's not like I made these cookies for you or anything. I just had extra.
items.exJa: 別にあんたのためにクッキーを作ったわけじゃないんだからね。余っただけよ。

items.m: ついて行く、一緒に行く
items.en: to go somewhere with someone, often without being invited
items.ex: Can I tag along to the arcade? I promise I won't get in your way.
items.exJa: ゲーセンについて行ってもいい？邪魔しないって約束するから。

items.m: どういうつもりだ
items.en: demanding an explanation for someone's annoying behavior
items.ex: Hey, what's the big idea? Why did you lock me out of my own room?
items.exJa: おい、どういうつもりだ？なんで俺を自分の部屋から閉め出したんだ？

items.m: 怖がり、臆病者
items.en: a childish word for someone who is easily frightened
items.ex: It's just a little thunder, you scaredy-cat. Come out from under the blanket.
items.exJa: ただの雷だよ、怖がりだなあ。毛布の下から出ておいで。

items.m: その話はやめて、もういい
items.en: telling someone to stop talking about a topic
items.ex: I already said I don't want to talk about my father, so just drop it.
items.exJa: 父のことは話したくないって言ったでしょ、その話はもうやめて。

items.m: さあね、全然分からない
items.en: an informal way of saying you do not know the answer
items.ex: "Where did the teacher go?" "Beats me, she just walked out in the middle of class."
items.exJa: 「先生どこ行ったの？」「さあね、授業の途中で出て行っちゃった」

items.m: ダサいやつ、変わり者
items.en: a socially awkward or silly person, often said affectionately
items.ex: You wore your costume to class again? You're such a dork, but I like that about you.
items.exJa: またコスプレで授業に来たの？ほんと変なやつ。でもそういうとこ好きだよ。

items.m: しらけさせる人、興ざめ
items.en: a person or thing that spoils other people's fun
items.ex: Don't be such a buzzkill, we're only staying at the festival one more hour.
items.exJa: しらけさせないでよ、お祭りにいるのはあと1時間だけだから。

items.m: 他にやることないのか
items.en: telling someone to stop wasting time on unimportant things
items.ex: You spent the whole weekend counting my mistakes in the game? Get a life.
items.exJa: 週末ずっと私のゲームのミスを数えてたの？他にやることないわけ？

items.m: 場をしらけさせる人
items.en: a person who refuses to join in or spoils others' fun
items.ex: Come on, sing one song at karaoke. Don't be a party pooper tonight.
items.exJa: ねえ、カラオケで一曲歌ってよ。今夜は場をしらけさせないで。

items.m: 残念、がっかり
items.en: a disappointing or unpleasant situation
items.ex: The fireworks festival got canceled because of the typhoon? What a bummer.
items.exJa: 台風で花火大会が中止？がっかりだね。

items.m: 生意気なやつ、知ったかぶり
items.en: a person who makes annoying, clever remarks to seem smart
items.ex: Okay, wise guy, if you know so much, why don't you solve the riddle?
items.exJa: いいだろう、生意気な奴め。そんなに詳しいならお前が謎を解いてみろ。

items.m: カモ、騙されやすい人
items.en: a person who is easily tricked or persuaded
items.ex: He paid ten gold coins for a fake treasure map? What a sucker.
items.exJa: 偽の宝の地図に金貨10枚も払ったの？とんだカモだね。

items.m: 勝手にすれば、ご自由に
items.en: said to let someone do what they want, often with disapproval
items.ex: You'd rather sleep outside in the rain than share a room with me? Suit yourself.
items.exJa: 私と同じ部屋より雨の中で外で寝る方がいいの？ご自由に。

items.w: who do you think you are
items.m: 何様のつもりだ
items.en: angrily asking why someone acts as if they have special authority
items.ex: Who do you think you are, giving me orders on my own ship?
items.f: Who do you think you are
items.exJa: 何様のつもりだ、俺の船で俺に命令するとは？

items.m: お前は引っ込んでろ、口を出すな
items.en: telling someone not to get involved in a matter
items.ex: This is between me and him, so stay out of this, no matter what happens.
items.exJa: これは俺とあいつの問題だ。何があってもお前は手を出すな。

items.m: 駄目もとでやってみる、いくぞ
items.en: said before trying something that may well fail
items.ex: I've never jumped this far before, but here goes nothing. Wish me luck!
items.exJa: こんなに遠くまで跳んだことないけど、駄目もとでいくよ。幸運を祈ってて！

items.m: しくじる、チャンスを逃す
items.en: to waste a chance or fail at something by making a mistake
items.ex: This is our only chance to get into the castle, so please don't blow it.
items.exJa: 城に入るチャンスはこれだけなんだから、頼むからしくじらないでね。

items.m: 大したことない、それがどうした
items.en: used to say something is not important or impressive
items.ex: So you got a higher score than me on one test. Big deal, I'll win next time.
items.exJa: 一回のテストで僕より点が高かっただけでしょ。それがどうした、次は勝つよ。

items.m: そういう問題じゃない
items.en: said when someone has missed the important issue
items.ex: Yes, we won the match, but that's not the point. You ignored the whole team!
items.exJa: 確かに試合には勝った、でもそういう問題じゃない。お前はチーム全員を無視したんだ！

items.m: 人のこと言えるのか
items.en: said when someone criticizes a fault they also have
items.ex: "You're always late." "Look who's talking, you showed up an hour late yesterday."
items.exJa: 「君はいつも遅刻するね」「人のこと言える？昨日1時間遅れて来たくせに」

items.m: 誰にも言わない、口外しない
items.en: a promise to keep a secret
items.ex: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about your secret identity. My lips are sealed.
items.exJa: 心配しないで、あなたの正体は誰にも言わない。口は堅いから。

items.m: そう来なくちゃ、いいね
items.en: said when a suggestion is much better than what came before
items.ex: A buffet with unlimited desserts instead of salad? Now we're talking!
items.exJa: サラダじゃなくてデザート食べ放題のビュッフェ？そう来なくちゃ！

items.m: よくやった、さすが
items.en: said to praise someone for doing well; also used sarcastically
items.ex: You scored the winning goal in the last second? Way to go, captain!
items.exJa: 最後の一秒で決勝ゴールを決めたって？さすがだね、キャプテン！

items.m: ありえない、絶対だめ
items.en: said to emphasize that something will definitely not happen
items.ex: You want me to hand over the map to a stranger? Not a chance.
items.exJa: 見知らぬ奴に地図を渡せって？絶対にお断りだ。

items.m: 情けない、哀れな
items.en: so weak or poor that it makes people feel pity or contempt
items.ex: Running away from a fight after all that bragging? You're pathetic.
items.exJa: あれだけ大口叩いておいて戦いから逃げるのか？情けない奴だ。

items.m: 冷静さを保つ
items.en: to stay calm in a difficult or stressful situation
items.ex: No matter how much he provokes you during the duel, keep your cool.
items.exJa: 決闘中にどれだけ挑発されても、冷静さを保つんだ。

items.m: ～にちょっかいを出す、からかう
items.en: to bother, tease, or cause trouble for someone
items.ex: Don't mess with the quiet girl in the back. I heard she's a black belt.
items.exJa: 後ろの席の大人しい子にちょっかい出すなよ。黒帯らしいぞ。

items.m: ちゃんと聞いてるよ、聞かせて
items.en: said to show you are eager to listen
items.ex: You say you have a better plan than mine? Fine, I'm all ears.
items.exJa: 俺より良い作戦があるって？いいだろう、聞かせてもらおう。

items.m: マジで？、当たり前だろ
items.en: expressing surprise, or sarcastically saying something is obvious
items.ex: "This dungeon is really dangerous." "No kidding, we've almost died three times!"
items.exJa: 「このダンジョン、本当に危ないね」「当たり前だろ、三回も死にかけたんだぞ！」

items.m: 高嶺の花、手の届かない相手
items.en: too attractive, skilled, or high-status for someone to win
items.ex: Forget about asking the school idol out, man. She's way out of your league.
items.exJa: 学園のアイドルを誘うなんて諦めろよ。お前には高嶺の花すぎる。

items.m: 気にしてないよ
items.en: a reply showing you were not upset by a remark
items.ex: "Sorry, I didn't mean to call you short." "None taken, I'm used to it."
items.exJa: 「ごめん、チビって言うつもりじゃなかった」「気にしてないよ、慣れてるから」

items.m: ガキ、悪ガキ
items.en: a badly behaved, annoying child
items.ex: That spoiled brat kicked my shin and then ran crying to his mother.
items.exJa: あの甘やかされたガキ、俺のすねを蹴って泣きながら母親のとこへ逃げた。

items.m: もういい、気にしないで、お断り
items.en: said to dismiss something or refuse firmly
items.ex: Forget it, I'll fix the bike myself since nobody here wants to help.
items.exJa: もういいよ、誰も手伝ってくれないなら自分で自転車直すから。
